searchText: Another bad Goerli block. It seems like bad tx signature again: ``` Number: 7550596 Hash: 0x5b0133d49c8866d67af1a83be7b59d0f04443d98d0bd6f5ce9a389eb1058e846 Error: could not apply tx 10 [0x9fc79b663ec886bcb6f873bf86e57336fce715b5b17c068c3d468a8dec3419b0]: invalid transaction v, r, s values ``` do we know proposer? It is actually exposes a subset of `eth` methods, if you want `web3_` to be in the list you may submit a PR Deprecation notice for MSF12! It'll be deleted later today. We will have MSF13 and Goerli for testing. MSF13 will merge tomorrow. Probably is an old Erigon instance Is optimistic sync the mechanism that all EL/CL pairs currently use to sync a new node, or is there another spec I should be looking at for _current_ behavior? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/sync/optimistic.md ^ what I'm particularly looking for is something that explains the initial handshake when a EL/CL pair starts up after e.g. being offline for some period of time, how the two determine what to do next over the engine API
